finalText:
Migration complete — 30 `db.query` call sites across 12 files rewritten to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

- `packages/accounts`: `repo/session.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js`
- `packages/billing`: `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog`: `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders`: `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support`: `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics`: `repo/cohort.js`

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13`** still uses `db.query`. Its header says the file is replaced wholesale on upgrade and local edits are silently lost, so patching it there would be undone. It needs either an upstream legacy-orm bump or a local wrapper — your call which.
- **`cache.query(...)`** in the repo files is `lib/cache.js`, an unrelated API — not part of this migration.
